security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost blob: data:; media-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Photos and videos analyzed and sorted by a local vision model
bundle.longDescription: Point Agentic Binning at a folder of photos and videos. A vision model running on this computer's Snapdragon NPU through GenieX names, describes and categorizes every shot, and Bin Files moves them into category folders.
